clips.title: O'Hare Tower — evening departure push
clips.description: Three airliners take off one after another from runway 28 Right while the tower feeds each one onto the runway behind the last.

clips.title: Kennedy Tower — arrivals and a go-around
clips.description: A Delta jet has only just touched down when a British Airways 777 arrives too close behind it, so the tower orders the 777 to abort its landing and climb away while a JetBlue departs alongside.

clips.title: San Francisco Tower — side-by-side arrivals
clips.description: Two jets land side by side on San Francisco's close parallel runways while a Southwest 737 waits to take off across their path.
